name: file_search
description: Search for a text pattern across files in a directory. Supports regex. Uses ripgrep if available.

manual.overview: Use file_search to find patterns across a codebase. Works like grep/ripgrep — search by regex, filter by file type, and get results with line numbers. Essential for understanding unfamiliar code.

examples.description: Find all TODO comments in Python files

tips: Use glob filters to narrow results (e.g. '*.py' for Python only).
Start with broad patterns and narrow down if too many results.
Regex is supported: use '\bword\b' for whole-word matching.
edge_cases: Very large directories may be slow; use glob to limit scope.
The pattern is case-sensitive by default.
